architecture.title: Capstone — from a Shadow week to a defended (or held) version
architecture.caption: EXAMPLE design for this course, on the SIM agent, for the pilot family hvac_expert/fault_review/hotel_th. The plan is registered first. Four Shadow nights feed one capped weekly merge; a reviewer change gets its own refine-half probe; the gate requires the hash the reviewer read. Integrity tests and registered criteria run after the version is frozen, on the test half, and their verdicts go only into REVIEW.md at the gate.
